name: The Wanderer
aliases: Very pleasant swordswoman without a name
description: The Wanderer is a white-haired swordswoman and planeswalker who is secretly the lost Emperor of Kamigawa, bonded to the kami Kyodai.

summary.text: The Wanderer is a white-haired swordswoman and planeswalker who is secretly the lost Emperor of Kamigawa, bonded to the kami Kyodai.

bio.text: Tamiyo revealed that the Wanderer and the emperor were one and the same, and the Reality Chip fused to her hand stabilized her unstable spark for a time.
She planeswalked into Tameshi's compound, cleaved Jin-Gitaxias and freed Kaito and Tamiyo, then fought Risona in Kyodai's temple before naming Light-Paws her proxy and vanishing from Kamigawa again.
During the invasion of New Phyrexia she flickered in and out of planes, was frozen in an amber prison for a month in Zhalfir until freed, and warned Teferi that New Phyrexia's invasion was upon them.
Empowered by Kyodai, she cut Tamiyo down, and later accounts say she killed what remained of Tamiyo after her compleation.
Now without her spark, she told Ral she could not help him, then asked Kaito's help to find the missing Nashi and led a party through the door into the House on Duskmourn.

In the House she was rescued by Winter, found and freed Nashi, was captured by the Cult of Valgavoth, and then freed herself, gave Nashi a fateshifter and dueled Valgavoth before the team escaped to Ravnica.

status.text: She survived Duskmourn and, as of the latest story, remains the sparkless Emperor of Kamigawa, with Nashi back on Kamigawa telling children of their adventure.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo reveals the Reality Chip and that the Wanderer and the emperor are one and the same.
timeline.quote: "The Wanderer and the emperor are one and the same."

timeline.summary: The Reality Chip stirs, and a swordswoman cuts down the mech: the emperor, who is the Wanderer.
timeline.quote: The Wanderer.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo hides the henchmen with an invisibility spell, and the three planeswalkers flee Otawara.
timeline.quote: the three planeswalkers fled from Otawara in silence.

timeline.summary: Kaito, Tamiyo, and the emperor arrive in the emperor's garden in Eiganjo, and the emperor enters Kyodai's temple.
timeline.quote: She turned for the porch, slid open the door to Kyodai's temple, and disappeared inside.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Tamiyo find Kyodai reunited with the emperor, both in pain from the emperor's unstable spark.
timeline.quote: "Your spark is still unstable. You cannot remain on Kamigawa without help."

timeline.summary: Tamiyo places the Reality Chip on the emperor's hand and it fuses to her flesh, stabilizing her for a time.
timeline.quote: the wires fused to her flesh like veins pulsing with energy.

timeline.summary: The emperor reveals she has visions of the lab and that Jin-Gitaxias told Risona and the Uprisers of her return, so they will attack the palace.
timeline.quote: They plan to attack the palace imminently.

timeline.summary: The emperor tells Kaito she heard of his search across the planes and nearly met him many times.
timeline.quote: "Sometimes I was only a step behind you.

timeline.summary: Light-Paws and Eiko arrive and bow to the emperor, who orders the court to prepare against the Uprisers.
timeline.quote: We must prepare our forces at once."

timeline.summary: The emperor approves the plan to destroy the compound, and agrees to remain in Eiganjo.
timeline.quote: "I will remain here," she said at last.

timeline.summary: Kaito promises the emperor to free any captive kami before setting off the charge.
timeline.quote: "You have my word," Kaito replied.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer has a vision of the ambush and decides to planeswalk into the compound, with Eiko encouraging her to save Kaito.
timeline.quote: "They were ambushed by Tezzeret and Jin-Gitaxias."

timeline.summary: Using her bond with Kyodai to stabilize her spark, the Wanderer planeswalks to Tameshi's compound.
timeline.quote: the Wanderer planeswalked out of Eiganjo and into Tameshi's compound with a flash of light.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer cleaves Jin-Gitaxias with her sword and frees Kaito and Tamiyo from the surgical tables.
timeline.quote: The Wanderer brought her sword down like a blow from the heavens and cleaved Jin-Gitaxias from his neck to his chest.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer, Kaito and Tamiyo defeat the henchmen in the compound and hold Tezzeret paralyzed; the Wanderer decides to bring him to Kyodai.
timeline.quote: "Yes. We will decide his fate together."

timeline.summary: Tezzeret takes control of the Reality Chip on the Wanderer's hand, destabilizing her spark and linking her to Kyodai in agony.
timeline.quote: no time to shout a warning before Tezzeret took control of the Reality Chip.

timeline.summary: Kyodai warns the Wanderer through the bond that Risona has brought an army to Eiganjo.
timeline.quote: Risona has brought an army.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo removes the chip from the Wanderer's hand and then places it on her own hand to pilot a surveillance mech to Eiganjo.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo lifted the Reality Chip to the back of her own hand and pressed the panel to her flesh.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer disables a surveillance mech and the group flies to Eiganjo on its back, carrying Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: The mech let out a ragged groan before lowering its body to the ground

timeline.summary: Tezzeret wakes and flings Kaito's smoke devices, then jumps from the mech; Tamiyo loses control and the group jumps before the mech crashes.
timeline.quote: the mech exploding against the side of an Imperial apartment.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer fights Risona in Kyodai's temple and offers her surrender.
timeline.quote: "Drop your blade. There is no need for you to die this way."

timeline.summary: Kaito knocks Risona unconscious with a thrown rock and she is bound, ending the battle.
timeline.quote: something flew across the room and cracked against the side of her skull, knocking her unconscious.

timeline.summary: With her spark destabilizing, the emperor names Light-Paws her proxy to rule Kamigawa with Kyodai's blessing.
timeline.quote: "You will be my proxy, and rule Kamigawa for as long as I am unable."

timeline.summary: The emperor's spark takes hold and she vanishes from Kamigawa again.
timeline.quote: The spark took hold of her, and the emperor once again vanished from Kamigawa.

timeline.summary: Vraska, the Wanderer, Kaito, Tyvar and Lukka planeswalk in to join, and Kaya wraps the sylex for the journey.
timeline.quote: Soon, others began to planeswalk in.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer shakes Kaito and strikes him in the face, breaking the hypnotic spell so that he hears the battle around him.
timeline.quote: he realized that what he'd taken for the sound of waves was actually the sound of metal clashing on metal

timeline.summary: Kaito finds his sword and tanuki drone gone, and the Wanderer begins flickering out of the plane.
timeline.quote: He grabbed instinctively for his sword

timeline.summary: The group sets off across the metal desert toward the next landing zone, Nahiri warning that nothing Phyrexian can be trusted.
timeline.quote: You can't trust anything Phyrexian.

timeline.summary: The group finds a statue of an elf containing Zendikari hedron stone, suspended in cables, and Nahiri declares him one of their own.
timeline.quote: That's a Zendikari hedron.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Nahiri attack the living cables and cut the statue free, and the Wanderer kneels beside him.
timeline.quote: until, with a loud snapping sound, the last one broke and dumped him to the ground

timeline.summary: The freed statue reverts to flesh and introduces himself as Tyvar Kell, Prince of Kaldheim.
timeline.quote: I am Tyvar Kell, Prince of Kaldheim.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer finally flickers away, unable to stay on the plane, having seen Kaito out of the first danger.
timeline.quote: He turned to the Wanderer, intending to say something to boost her spirits and bolster her strength.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer returns to the razed camp too late and finds her companions gone.
timeline.quote: She had returned from the Blind Eternities too late, and they were lost.

timeline.summary: Lukka follows an angry cry and finds Nissa and the Wanderer fighting a Phyrexian construct on a bough.
timeline.quote: Lukka had seen them before: Nissa, and the woman was called . . . the Wanderer.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer decapitates the first creature, then vanishes with a flicker of light.
timeline.quote: Then, with a strange flicker of light, the Wanderer vanished.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer warns them of a Phyrexian monstrosity that attacks Nissa; the centaur hulk wraps wires around Lukka's spine and he kills the attacker with his harpoon.
timeline.quote: Veiny wires sprouted from its torso, plunging through his skin and wiggling through his gut to wrap around his spine.

timeline.summary: The group is attacked by leech-like creatures and a mother-beast; Lukka frees his Phyrexian by slicing through the mother-monstrosity with his now-metallic hands.
timeline.quote: He pulled apart a lip of flesh and freed his Phyrexian.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer reveals Vorinclex is nearby and recovered from his journey to Kaldheim, and Lukka and Nissa decide to attack him.
timeline.quote: We need to take him down before he hurts anyone else.

timeline.summary: Nissa, horrified, backs away as Lukka advances on her, and the Wanderer flickers in to shield her and tells her to run.
timeline.quote: Nissa, run!

timeline.summary: Teferi recognizes the described woman and her hat as the Wanderer.
timeline.quote: Not just any wanderer: the Wanderer.

timeline.summary: Queen Wezna tosses Teferi an amber prison holding the frozen Wanderer.
timeline.quote: Small, frozen in time, likely moments after planeswalking, a warrior mid-strike.

timeline.summary: A creed leader breaks the amber prison and the Wanderer is freed.
timeline.quote: the prison snapped, bursting open with a sharp report

timeline.summary: The Wanderer learns she has been in Zhalfir a month, and Teferi reasons the anchor failed.
timeline.quote: The anchor failed,

timeline.summary: The Wanderer tells them New Phyrexia's invasion is upon them before she flickers away.
timeline.quote: New Phyrexia's invasion is upon us,

timeline.summary: Kaito cuts himself free and is caught by Kyodai bearing the Wanderer.
timeline.quote: it's the emperor.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer confronts Tamiyo, who holds Nashi and takes out the scroll bound by an iron band.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo reaches for a scroll at her waist, one bound with an iron band.

timeline.summary: Empowered by Kyodai, the Wanderer cuts Tamiyo down.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo falls.

timeline.summary: Nashi, grieving, is comforted by Kaito, Kaya, the Wanderer and Kyodai.
timeline.quote: Even Kyodai wraps around them all.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer explains that Tamiyo's last act was a request that her missed shards and mouthed words showed, so the memory is true.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo was making a request, in the only way she could.

timeline.summary: Nashi recalls the day the Wanderer killed what remained of Tamiyo, after she was compleated.
timeline.quote: his mind was transported back to the day the Wanderer killed what had been left of Tamiyo.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer tells Ral she cannot help as her spark is gone, but advises him to open his soul at the last place he saw Jace.
timeline.quote: "I can no longer walk the planes. My spark is gone."

timeline.summary: The white-haired Wanderer appears behind Kaito and blocks his blade with her own.
timeline.quote: The white-haired woman standing behind him offered a slight smile, her sword still lifted to prevent him from completing a stroke.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer tells Kaito she needs his help because Nashi is in trouble.
timeline.quote: I came because I need your help. Nashi's in trouble.

timeline.summary: Kaito, with the scroll in hand, tells the Wanderer he will return it to Genku, Tamiyo's widower, by morning.
timeline.quote: Genku will have his lost wife's scroll back in the library come morning.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer reveals Nashi has been missing for three months.
timeline.quote: Three months.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer recounts how Nashi followed his mother's voice to a carved door, sent drones through, and then went in with friends, after which the door vanished.
timeline.quote: He followed her call to a door covered in strange carvings, one that had no place in Kamigawa.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer says she traced the door's echo through the Omenpaths to Ravnica, where Niv-Mizzet guards it.
timeline.quote: I found it on Ravnica, being guarded by Niv-Mizzet.

timeline.summary: Kaito arrives on Ravnica and wonders why he kept his spark when so many others lost theirs; Niko is bitter at their loss.
timeline.quote: Kaito stepped out of forever onto the streets of Ravnica

timeline.summary: At the door, researchers surround it; Aminatou recoils in fear and warns that it hears them.
timeline.quote: Aminatou gasped and recoiled as her eyes locked on the door.

timeline.summary: Aminatou hands out the fateshifter tokens, giving the Wanderer a second.
timeline.quote: She handed them around the members of the team, giving the Wanderer a second.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer asks Aminatou to mind Yoshimaru while the team goes in.
timeline.quote: Will you mind Yoshimaru for me?

timeline.summary: The team takes Etrata's monitoring devices and files through the door into the House.
timeline.quote: One by one, the group filed inside.

timeline.summary: The party moves down a dusty hallway and discovers the door they came through has vanished.
timeline.quote: The door's gone

timeline.summary: Kaito reads the air in the parlor and concludes someone was recently there.
timeline.quote: I don't know if Nashi was here recently, but someone was

timeline.summary: The Wanderer finds a family photo with the adults' faces scratched out and the daughter smiling.
timeline.quote: The faces of the adults had been scratched out, reduced to white scabs on the paper

timeline.summary: The party finds an abandoned funfair in a cornfield beyond glass doors, but Zimone shows the sky is a glass ceiling, so it is still the House.
timeline.quote: If they were indoors, there could be no breeze, and without a breeze, why was it moving?

timeline.summary: The Wanderer refuses Kaito's idea of scouting the rooftops, insisting the group stay visible to one another.
timeline.quote: You were the one who realized we had to stay ever visible to one another.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer says the House feels like a shell encasing all that remained of the plane, and decides they should return to where the door vanished.
timeline.quote: This feels like a shell surrounding everything there is of what once was, and I fear it has no limits.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Niko realize the doorway moved and skewed Niko's aim, so the trap was deliberate.
timeline.quote: The doorway moved as Tyvar passed through it.

timeline.summary: Kaito steps toward the doorway and the floor opens into a toothed mouth; he falls into blackness as the Wanderer fails to catch him.
timeline.quote: The floor he stepped onto opened like the mouth of a lamprey

timeline.summary: Niko holds the Wanderer back from jumping after Kaito, and the hole disappears.
timeline.quote: The Wanderer tensed as if to jump after him, only to stop when Niko grabbed her wrist.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer tells Niko she killed Nashi's mother in the invasion; Niko argues Phyrexia is to blame.
timeline.quote: I was sorry to kill her.

timeline.summary: Niko and the Wanderer enter a freezing meat locker with hanging carcasses.
timeline.quote: heavy iron chains hanging from the ceiling, the hooks at their ends driven into massive cuts of meat

timeline.summary: A stranger yanks Niko and the Wanderer behind a hanging carcass, just before a masked figure appears.
timeline.quote: yanked them hard behind the nearest hanging, flensed behemoth

timeline.summary: A tall razorkin with a cleaver stalks through the carcasses toward them.
timeline.quote: a figure came stalking through the carcasses, tall and wiry.

timeline.summary: Winter lures the razorkin into a beartrap by rattling a chain and leads Niko and the Wanderer out.
timeline.quote: only to step into a beartrap that had been concealed by the fog on the floor.

timeline.summary: Winter tells them he has lived in the House most of his life and that the House is the whole world.
timeline.quote: The House is the world, and the world is the House, and once it has hold of you, there's nowhere else to go.

timeline.summary: Winter stops Niko and the Wanderer from stepping on the moths woven into the carpet.
timeline.quote: Don't step on any of the moths!

timeline.summary: Winter explains that the door they came through was a lure and that Duskmourn now holds them.
timeline.quote: But when you tried to turn around and go, the door wasn't there anymore.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer tells Winter they came to find a lost child, Nashi.
timeline.quote: We came seeking a child who has been lost

timeline.summary: The Wanderer draws her sword on Winter and warns him not to taunt them.
timeline.quote: Her sword, which had been belted at her hip, was suddenly in her hands, the blade only inches from Winter's face.

timeline.summary: Winter explains that the House splits groups to isolate and frighten them.
timeline.quote: That's Duskmourn, splitting you from your friends

timeline.summary: Winter points out the Wanderer's glimmer, a golden dragon of light; she reacts as if to Kyodai but recognizes it is not.
timeline.quote: There, floating several feet above the parlor floor, hovered a golden dragon etched entirely of light

timeline.summary: The glimmer leads the group through a doorway on a safe path.
timeline.quote: the glimmer began to swim through the air to a doorway on the far wall.

timeline.summary: The glimmer of Kyodai leads Winter, Niko and the Wanderer through the House, ignored by its horrors.
timeline.quote: The gleaming golden shadow of Kyodai led them onward

timeline.summary: Winter tells the Wanderer that the House has taken the whole outside, leaving everything inside.
timeline.quote: There's no outside left.

timeline.summary: The group discovers a clearing where wickerfolk dance around a cold fire next to cages of nezumi captives.
timeline.quote: There were seven in all, four of them occupied by humanoid rats

timeline.summary: The Wanderer sees Nashi, the smallest captive, silently watching the wickerfolk.
timeline.quote: eyes fixed on the smallest of the rat-people, who sat at the bottom of his cage, arms around his knees

timeline.summary: In a fateshifter vision, the Wanderer charges, cuts open Nashi's cage and is killed by branches bursting from her ribs.
timeline.quote: Blood began to blossom on the front of her tabard before tree branches burst out of her ribcage

timeline.summary: The vision shatters as the Wanderer clutches Aminatou's fateshifter, having narrowly averted the choice.
timeline.quote: the vision shattered as the Wanderer gasped, hand going to the pocket where she had tucked Aminatou's fateshifter

timeline.summary: The Wanderer frees the other captive nezumi, who say wickerfolk fear fire.
timeline.quote: The Wanderer dodged them easily, moving to cut the other occupied cages open.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer uses Winter's lighter to ignite grass and drive the wickerfolk into the woods.
timeline.quote: A tiny flame shot out, and the grass lit up, burning like a beacon.

timeline.summary: Niko releases Nashi from the shard and the Wanderer embraces him; he pulls away.
timeline.quote: Nashi was suddenly standing there, looking perplexed for only a moment before the Wanderer pulled him into an embrace.

timeline.summary: Nashi asks for help to find his mother after losing most of his crew.
timeline.quote: I've been searching for my mother since I got here

timeline.summary: Nashi refuses to talk to the Wanderer, saying the House took his mother and he will not leave her.
timeline.quote: This house took my mother. We're going to get her back.

timeline.summary: Winter warns that they have entered the Valley of Serenity, home of the Cult of Valgavoth; Nashi insists on continuing.
timeline.quote: The Cult of Valgavoth lives here.

timeline.summary: The party enters a cavern of robed cultists who hold three bound survivors and hang chrysalises.
timeline.quote: Half a dozen humanoid figures in long robes shaped like moth's wings

timeline.summary: Cultists seize the Wanderer, Nashi and Niko while Winter bows his head and does not resist.
timeline.quote: Winter only bowed his head, saying nothing, as the cultists rose up and grabbed Niko in turn.

timeline.summary: Winter drops a granite slab that seals the others in with the cultists.
timeline.quote: A slab of solid granite crashed down between him and the others, sealing them in the room with the cultists.

timeline.summary: The cult leader's book releases silver dust that knocks the captives unconscious.
timeline.quote: their leader raised his book and blew across the pages, and a thick layer of dust rolled off the paper

timeline.summary: The Wanderer wakes bound to a post in a larger cavern.
timeline.quote: she was able to shake off the lingering effects of the sedative dust to find herself held up by loops of some white, cottony material, pinning her tightly to a post.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer sees Tamiyo's scroll echo held in a device as a cultist records her stories.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo's scroll echo floated there, flickering in and out of focus, like it hurt her to be manifest.

timeline.summary: The cult leader offers the Wanderer a chance to join them.
timeline.quote: we would be gloriously glad if you would join us

timeline.summary: Niko wakes bound to a chair with the Wanderer and Nashi in a cult chamber hung with chrysalises.
timeline.quote: They still couldn't move their hands or feet.

timeline.summary: The head cultist appears and recites the cult's blessing.
timeline.quote: the head cultist walked between them and the Wanderer, still carrying his book.

timeline.summary: The head cultist says the captives' knowledge of other worlds will guide the Devouring Father to his next feast.
timeline.quote: Your knowledge will be added to the great list, and with it we will guide the Devouring Father to his next feasting place.

timeline.summary: Niko frees the Wanderer who retrieves her sword.
timeline.quote: They sliced through the ropes holding her arms and legs to the chair

timeline.summary: The Wanderer frees Nashi and gives him a small object, saying he can change his fate.
timeline.quote: You can change your fate

timeline.summary: The Wanderer leaps onto the altar and duels the giant moth.
timeline.quote: The Wanderer had leapt up onto the stone altar, and was dueling the massive demon moth

timeline.summary: Valgavoth pins the Wanderer and threatens to unmake her world.
timeline.quote: I will swallow everything you are, and I will unmake your world in my own image

timeline.summary: The team escapes through the door, with Kaito covering Tyvar against a nightmare.
timeline.quote: Together they ran for the door.

timeline.summary: The team steps out onto Ravnica.
timeline.quote: stepping with them out into the light of the Ravnican afternoon.

timeline.summary: Back on Kamigawa, Nashi tells children the story of their adventure.
timeline.quote: watching as Nashi spun the story of their adventures to a crowd of rapt youngsters.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer appears without warning to aid a battle or defend the innocent, then vanishes.
timeline.quote: she appears without warning to aid in a battle or defend the innocent, only to disappear just as suddenly without explanation.

timeline.summary: It is revealed to a select few that the Wanderer is the lost empress of Kamigawa, seeking a way home.
timeline.quote: the Wanderer is the lost empress of Kamigawa, seeking a way to finally return home for good.

relations.note: bonded kami and emperor
relations.quote: It's because of our bond—the uncertainty of my spark affects her a great deal."

relations.note: tells the emperor Kamigawa needs her
relations.quote: "Kamigawa needs an emperor," Light-Paws interjected.

relations.note: childhood friends reunited
relations.quote: They were two friends in the Imperial Palace

relations.note: named proxy ruler as Regent
relations.quote: "You will be my proxy, and rule Kamigawa for as long as I am unable."

relations.note: storms the palace and fights the emperor
relations.quote: "You stormed the palace and murdered dozens."

relations.note: bonded kami and emperor
relations.quote: The bond between the great kami and the emperor had always been strong.

relations.note: childhood friend who fights beside him
relations.quote: She had been able to hold on long enough to see her childhood friend out of the initial danger

relations.note: an old companion who brings news of the invasion
relations.quote: The Wanderer crouched down next to him

relations.note: cut her down with Kyodai's power
relations.quote: Tamiyo falls.

relations.note: Kyodai's soul is bound to the emperor
relations.quote: the guardian spirit of Kamigawa whose soul is bound to the emperor

relations.note: The Wanderer killed what remained of Tamiyo after her compleation.
relations.quote: the day the Wanderer killed what had been left of Tamiyo

relations.note: Old friends; she calls him old friend.
relations.quote: Hello, old friend

relations.note: She is its Emperor and has left Light-Paws as regent.
relations.quote: she had asked Light-Paws to maintain her regency for now

relations.note: Her beloved dog.
relations.quote: finally joyous again in the company of his beloved master

relations.note: She says she killed Nashi's mother, who had been taken by Phyrexia; Tamiyo is not named on this page.
relations.quote: I was sorry to kill her.

relations.note: Rescues her and Niko and leads them out of the locker.
relations.quote: The stranger pocketed his slingshot before gesturing for the others to follow him

relations.note: Keeps her from jumping after Kaito.
relations.quote: Not even for Kaito. He's the only one of us who can get out on his own.

relations.note: Calls Kyodai her dear one and would not wish her in the House.
relations.quote: This spirit is too small to be my dear one.

relations.note: She rescues him but he refuses to listen to her.
relations.quote: Of course I came

relations.note: They hold her captive and call her a heretic.
relations.quote: If you wish to remain heretics, I cannot save you

pages_say.description: A planeswalker, who is the emperor of Kamigawa, whose spark was set off by Tezzeret's Reality Chip; she appears with a sword and saves Kaito.
A planeswalker who is also the Emperor of Kamigawa, with an unstable spark stabilized for a time by the Reality Chip fused to her hand.
A planeswalker and the Emperor of Kamigawa, whose spark destabilizes and takes her from Kamigawa again after she names Light-Paws her proxy.
An elegant, fierce planeswalker who arrives with Kaito Shizuki.
A white-haired planeswalker and Kaito's childhood friend, who can barely hold herself on New Phyrexia and keeps flickering back into the Blind Eternities.
A planeswalker whose unpredictable spark makes her flicker before she departs for the Blind Eternities.
A white-haired planeswalker who keeps flickering in and out of the plane as she tries to remain stable.
A white-haired planeswalker found in an amber prison who brings news of New Phyrexia's invasion.
A planeswalker who is thought to have escaped home.
A white-haired planeswalker and emperor of Kamigawa bound to Kyodai, who strikes down Tamiyo.
The figure who killed what was left of Tamiyo with her sword.
A white-haired planeswalker who lost her spark, living in a palace garden, who tells Ral how to trace aether trails.
The Emperor of Kamigawa, no longer a planeswalker, who walks among her people and asks Kaito's help to find the missing Nashi.
The former planeswalker Emperor of Kamigawa, who still senses the planes and insists on keeping the party together.
The sparkless Emperor of Kamigawa who is searching for Nashi and threatens Winter with her sword.
The sparkless Emperor of Kamigawa whose glimmer is the golden dragon Kyodai; she finds Nashi and nearly dies in a fateshifter vision.
The sparkless Emperor of Kamigawa, captured by the cult with Nashi and Niko.
The sparkless Emperor of Kamigawa who duels Valgavoth with a glowing sword and gives Nashi a fateshifter.
A cypher and traveling swordswoman of incredible skill who hides her features behind a wide-brimmed hat; secretly the lost empress of Kamigawa.
